# Generate launchd Plists

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `launchd.generate-plist.workflow` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/launchd.yaml` |
| Tags | launchd, workflow |

Emits one `.plist` file per definition that declares a `launchd:` block, by
iterating `runtime.catalog.definitions` and filtering on `has_launchd`.
Defaults write into `09_launchd/` next to the authoring YAML.

### Run Operations

#### Emit one `.plist` per launchd definition

_No operation description provided._

```launchd_plist
launchd_plist:
  definition: '{{ definition.id }}'
  target_path: '{{ output_dir }}/{{ definition.id }}.plist'
  mode: '{{ mode }}'
for_each:
  items: runtime.catalog.definitions | selectattr('has_launchd') | rejectattr('id',
    'equalto', 'launchd.base') | list
  as: definition
```
